data.retirementDetails: Congratulations to Frances and Nick on having a carbon neutral wedding.  Fifty-four tons of CO2e have been retired in your name.  The credits come from a Tradewater project in Ghana that collected and destroyed chlorofluorocarbons found in a stockpile in Accra.  The volume of credits represents the emissions associated with all the travel from all your guests to the wedding, including flights and ground transportation.  To make the calculation, we used emission factors from the GHG Protocol.  We are so happy for you both and wish you long and healthy lives together with many adventures.  Much love,  Tim, Jill, Della, and Jackie

99 in partnership with ZScore will offset all carbon emissions of the app rides within the city of Manaus.
99 is an urban mobility App and ZScore runs a coalition program that promotes sustainable development initiatives.
